limits: Reset-state electrical check of one pin with every rail at its sourced recommended maximum: the pin, shorted to ground, must draw only its sourced leakage (floating input) or its sourced pull-up current. Firmware, clocks, peripherals and output drive are not modeled; the leakage term of the hashed pad is zero, so the leakage check bounds the model from above only.
